credits_text: AFTER WITNESSING WHAT HE BELIEVED TO BE A VAMPIRE ATTACK, A SLACKER IS CONVINCED HIS BUDDY'S NEW GIRLFRIEND IS THE CULPRIT. TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE IN THIS SATIRICAL TAKE ON THE CLASSIC VAMPIRE TALE.
other_text: AMATEUR SKETCH HAVE YOU SEEN THIS PERSON?
description: A poster for the film 'VAMP' features bold typography and a simple illustration of a face, promoting a satirical take on vampire tales.
